name: Chapter 938. Juvenile justice code
scope: chapter Wis. Stat. ch. 938 (Legislative Reference Bureau, chapter pages)

notice.label: Notice before it is used on a person
notice.quote: If a citation is issued to a juvenile, the issuing agency shall notify the juvenile’s parent, guardian, and legal custodian within 7 days.

hearing.label: A chance to answer before the decision is final
hearing.quote: If, after a hearing on the issue with due notice to the parent or guardian, the court finds that disclosure of the identity of the foster parent would result in imminent danger to the juvenile or the foster parent, the court may order the name and address of the prospective foste
hearing.quote_through: If no motion is filed within those 10 days or if, after hearing, the court determines that no good cause has been shown for setting aside the order, the law enforcement agency shall disclose the juvenile’s record as ordered.

appeal.label: A way to a court or an independent reviewer
appeal.quote_through: If an appeal is taken by any party and the guardian ad litem chooses not to participate in the appeal, he or she shall file with the appellate court a statement of reasons for not participating.

access.label: The person can see the record

access.quote_through: Copies of all law enforcement officer reports, including the officer’s memorandum and witnesses’ statements, shall be made available upon request to counsel or guardian ad litem prior to a plea hearing.
